en: Black‑and‑white view of a busy European city square with tram tracks, several trams, early‑mid 20th century cars, and many pedestrians. In the center of the square stands a prominent stone pyramid monument. On the right is a long neoclassical building with arched ground‑floor arcades and the words "BADISCHE SPARKASSE" on its facade. Behind it rises a church tower. The scene is framed like a typical vintage postcard photograph.
